failure_summary.description: Searches or refinements were left unsaved, despite the skill requiring each result to be cached.
Agents omitted a newly supplied neighborhood or amenity constraint, or missed a follow-up request implied by context.
Agents added inferred preferences, resent criteria already covered by cache, or sent a criterion to an incompatible domain tool.
An agent printed the no-planning message after performing a refinement.

patch.reasoning: The omitted saves, missed constraints, and invalid arguments already violate explicit skill rules, so adding more of the same would be duplicative. Clarify the remaining ambiguity: a completed tool call cannot retroactively make the plan a no-op.

edits.target: - Before emitting code, audit the planned calls against the latest turn and full conversation: for each new request or accepted preference, identify its intended item, domain, relation, and schema-supported argument, then verify that a planned call includes it. Do not reprocess unchanged domains. Use only a listed, compatible cache result for refinement; if none exists and mandatory inputs are available, search instead of filtering. After the audit, use `print("No planning needed")` only if no requested action or constraint remains unsatisfied by valid cached results.
edits.content: - Before emitting code, audit the planned calls against the latest turn and full conversation: for each new request or accepted preference, identify its intended item, domain, relation, and schema-supported argument, then verify that a planned call includes it. Do not reprocess unchanged domains. Use only a listed, compatible cache result for refinement; if none exists and mandatory inputs are available, search instead of filtering. After the audit, use `print("No planning needed")` only if no requested action or constraint remains unsatisfied by valid cached results and no planning operation is required. Never append it after executing a search, filter, sort, nearest-results call, or other planning operation.
